annotation.authors_or_issuer: Pedro Hernando Flórez Porras (Senador); Gerson Lisímaco Montaño Arizala (Representante a la Cámara), Comisión Sexta Constitucional, Congreso de Colombia
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to all natural and legal persons across the AI lifecycle with territorial link or effects in Colombia.
Establishes risk categorisation of AI systems and requires existing systems to comply upon entry into force.
Promotes AI education integration in higher education and labor transition measures.
Financing via international cooperation and public-private partnerships, subject to budget availability.
Fills regulatory gap left by CONPES 4144 of 2025 national AI policy.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Positive committee report for first debate on Colombia's Bill 043/2025 Senate – 324/2025 Chamber regulating AI. It presents the bill's background, rationale and a comparison table of the text, covering ethical principles, risk categorisation, transparency, education, labor transition, financing and compliance of existing systems. It contains no robot-specific provisions.
annotation.title_clean: Informe de Ponencia Positiva para Primer Debate al Proyecto de Ley No. 043 de 2025 Senado - 324 de 2025 Cámara, por medio del cual se regula la inteligencia artificial en Colombia
annotation.title_en: Positive Committee Report for First Debate on Bill No. 043 of 2025 Senate – 324 of 2025 Chamber, regulating artificial intelligence in Colombia
